checks.name: Native orbit exposes the actual underside of the toilet
A native underside guide attaches to the bottom surface
Top view occludes the underside guide behind a real surface
Occluded guide body cannot be selected through the toilet

Two visible lid guides coexist with the occluded underside guide
Toilet marquee uses full containment and excludes hidden geometry left-to-right
Toilet marquee uses full containment and excludes hidden geometry right-to-left
Toilet marquees create no document history
A partially contained lid guide is not marquee-selected
Invalid group release preserves every guide and history atomically
Invalid group release produces one incident for the entire group
Hidden guide overlays cannot receive body selections
Density-input keyboard ownership prevents guide deletion or tool shortcuts
Twenty source/orbit-view cycles preserve the exact saved toilet guides
Retained JS heap grows by less than 8 MiB across forty source switches

scope: Native underside orbit/drawing, real occlusion, source-pane selection at DPR 2, whole-group rejection, keyboard ownership and forty source switches. JS heap after GC is measured; this is a bounded repeat-use test, not an indefinite GPU-memory guarantee.
harnessNote: Initial orbit setup left keyboard focus on the Select button, so Space correctly activated that button instead of navigation. Occlusion/marquee assertions depending on the unachieved underside pose are invalid evidence. The corrected harness focuses the canvas and requires actual bottom-surface hits before proceeding. The independent repeat-use and rollback observations remain recorded.
